newsitem.title: INDIA: Volvo signs car plant deal in India. [CORRECTED 17:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Volvo signs car plant deal in India. [CORRECTED 17:55 GMT]

text.p: Sweden's AB Volvo automobile giant signed on Thursday a memorandum of understanding with India's southern state of Karnataka for a car plant with a planned initial investment of $86 million, a company statement said.

"AB Volvo of Sweden today formally announced its decision to establish operations in the state of Karnataka with initial investment of about three billion (corrects from 30 billion) rupees in the first phase of operations," the statement faxed from the state capital of Bangalore said.
"Volvo India will initially focus on heavy commercial vehicles," it said. "The manufacturing plant to be set up in Banglaore district, is expected t commence production during 1998."
